text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright and I decide against racing in the Takarazuka Kinen, but arrive at the racecourse to spectate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After witnessing Silence Suzuka's otherworldly speed, Mejiro Bright finds herself at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka's determination to perfect her running style fills Mejiro Bright with motivation to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to race together at the autumn Tenno Sho.
